# Codex plan card

## Intended result

Show the complete plan in a readable card. Keep the implementation choices below its scrolling body.

## Implementation

- Preserve the native actions and their descriptions.
- Match the plan against the journal before restoring the complete Markdown.
- Keep code, tables and paragraphs readable on a narrow phone.

```ts
const action = "review before implementation";
console.log(action);
```

## Verification

Check the original plan, the selected native option and the final result. This is the final paragraph of the short plan.
